smt-2024-calculus-tiebreaker-02.prompt:
A curve contained in the first quadrant of the $xy$-plane originates from $(1,0)$ and has the following property: at each point $(x,y)$ on the curve, the segment of the tangent line connecting $(x,y)$ to the intersection of the tangent with the $y$-axis has length $1$.

What is the area of the region bounded by the curve, the $x$-axis, and the $y$-axis?
